answers.answer: bronze.customers_raw is loaded nightly by the legacy customer-sync job, which copies the Azure SQL table dbo.customers from the sales DW into Databricks. The source is dbo.customers (Azure SQL).

Returns arrive as a daily CSV drop from the returns portal vendor into ADLS at abfss://landing@harborlake.dfs.core.windows.net/returns and Auto Loader ingests it into bronze.returns_raw. The source system is Azure Data Lake Storage.

Finance prepares a monthly credit-note and accrual workbook in Excel. A Power Automate flow lands it in ADLS at abfss://finance@harborlake.dfs.core.windows.net/gl_adjustments and a Databricks job loads it into finance.revenue_adjustments. The source system is Azure Data Lake Storage.
Yes, confirmed. orders_clean feeds orders_adjusted in the finance adjustments notebook (the table names come from the job config).
Yes, correct. The adjustments table is left-joined on order_id and adjustment_amount is added to net_amount.
Yes. gold_net_revenue_by_segment feeds the Power BI dataset 'Executive Net Revenue' (workspace Finance-Exec), which drives the CFO dashboard. The target system is Power BI.
Yes. reporting.daily_sales_summary feeds the SSRS report 'Monthly Revenue Pack', which Finance still reconciles against. The target system is a BI reporting tool (SSRS).
